title: Mia's diary says she can read minds, then home tests during COVID

tellings.quote: diary and in her diary she said I can read my parents Minds she wrote in her diary that she can read everybody's mind

plain: A girl named Mia in Monterrey, Mexico, is said to have written in her diary that she could read her parents' minds, and in fact everybody's mind, and was then tested at home during the COVID pandemic, between 2020 and 2022. The story is told by Ky Dickens, a filmmaker behind a documentary about telepathy in children, who relays what she was told about the diary and the home tests. If true, it would point to a child reading thoughts.
